distribution.start_visibility: static wall must not block the line from each spawn to its assigned end (episode generation only)
distribution.limits: static rejection alters accepted strata; accepted plan is the source of actual coverage. Intermediate placed objects and moving work peers are a later collection stage.
distribution.start_nominal_goal_feasible: both assigned nominal goals must clear static walls/bounds; exclusions and original-plan fraction in nominal_goal_filter

criteria.single_end: bilateral >=0.5N each and end rise >=12mm for >=1s
criteria.pair: both bilateral >=0.5 N, whole beam min_z >=12 mm, tilt <=10 deg for >=3 seconds
criteria.first_attempt: no teacher regrasp in this gate

nominal_goal_filter.criterion: same nominal_goal_blocked(static_map_only=True), folded planner clearance; walls/bounds only
nominal_goal_filter.scope: map-to-teacher handoff distribution; excludes static-blocked nominal stances, not a wide-start gate; no physical outcomes used
